description: This Java source file provides utility methods for handling files in the context of Feign API calls within the Fineract project. It includes functions for determining media types based on file extensions, extracting filenames from HTTP response headers, and probing content types of files.

classes.name: FeignParts
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for media type detection, filename extraction from HTTP responses, and content type probing for files.

methods.name: mediaType
methods.description: Determines the media type string based on the file extension of the provided filename.

methods.name: fileName
methods.description: Extracts the filename from the Content-Disposition header of an HTTP response, if present.

methods.name: probeContentType
methods.description: Probes the content type of a file using Files.probeContentType, falling back to mediaType based on filename extension if necessary.
